description: ROS 2 graph only; on a DDS-only setup use `list_participants`. List the nodes on the ROS 2 graph (or the mock graph) from one `ros2 node list` call as a `NodeListing`: `name`, `namespace`, `full_name`, `duplicate_count`, `lifecycle` (managed node; state not read, `lifecycle_note` if unknown), `by_namespace` counts. `duplicates` lists full names used by several nodes (a per-node tool then answers for one of them, unidentified). Nodes starting with an underscore are hidden and a node on another `ROS_DOMAIN_ID` is invisible. **Empty `nodes`** when the graph has none. Use `get_node_info` for one node's interfaces. **Raises an MCP error** without a `ros2` CLI. Read-only; cheap (two CLI calls). **Duration**: runs the `ros2` CLI behind the ROS lock (one call at a time); the whole call, lock wait included, ends within 45 s, and if another `ros2` call holds the lock it fails at once with a `busy` error (retry).
name: list_nodes

duplicate_count.description: Nodes using this exact full name; above 1, name-based tools answer for one of them.

full_name.description: Fully qualified node name, e.g. `/lidar_driver` or `/robot1/lidar_driver`.

lifecycle.description: True when the graph has `<full_name>/get_state` of type `lifecycle_msgs/srv/GetState` (a managed node). The state itself is never read.

name.description: Node name without its namespace, e.g. `lidar_driver`.

namespace.description: Namespace of the node: `/` for the root namespace, else e.g. `/robot1`.

by_namespace.description: Distinct full names per namespace (`/` is the root), sorted by namespace.

duplicates.description: Full names that appear more than once on the graph. Empty when every name is unique.

lifecycle_note.description: Why `lifecycle` could not be determined (service list failed), else `None`.

nodes.description: Nodes on the graph, one entry per distinct full name, sorted by name.

total.description: Distinct node names on the graph (no cap applies).

truncated.description: True when `returned` is less than `total` because of a cap.

title: List ROS 2 nodes
